latest_translations.summary: Peter Nasselstein's 2025 book "Oranur-Physik: Wilhelm Reich, Physicist - An Introduction to Orgone Biophysics," translated here from German. Nasselstein argues that Reich should be read as a physicist, presents the orgone energy accumulator and the ORANUR experiment, and links orgonomic functionalism to a range of later findings, including reported seasonal variation in radioactive decay. Later sections extend the argument to more speculative topics such as UFOs and hybrids; those are the author's own assessments.
points: Framed as an introduction to orgone biophysics and to Reich as a physicist, with a biophilosophical opening on Plato, Aristotle and Kant.
Covers the orgone accumulator, thermal and electroscopic orgonometry, and cosmic superimposition.
Cites Alburger's 1986 Brookhaven measurement of silicon-32: half-life 172 years, decay fastest in February and slowest in August.
Cites a 15-year radium-226 series at PTB Braunschweig and Ellis's nine-year plutonium-238 series showing about 0.5% seasonal swings.
Later chapters extend the argument to UFOs and to terrestrial-extraterrestrial hybrids, presented as the author's own reading.

The torsion-field attribution is the authors' interpretation; the paper reports no independent torsion-field measurement.

latest_translations.summary: E.M. Soroko's review, for the Academy of Trinitarianism, of A.P. Stakhov's book 'The Mathematics of Harmony: From Euclid to Contemporary Mathematics and Computer Science.' Soroko argues for what he calls nonlinear systemic synthesis over analytic reduction, and presents generalized Fibonacci numbers and generalized golden sections as the mathematical apparatus for the dynamics of self-organizing systems. The review is programmatic: it asserts the need for the apparatus rather than presenting experimental evidence for it.
points: Soroko contrasts analysis ("divide and rule") with what he calls nonlinear systemic synthesis.
States generalized Fibonacci sequences model cumulative growth ("yesterday plus today is tomorrow") versus simple repetition.
Notes Stakhov called the generalized golden sections p-numbers and Soroko independently called them s-numbers.
Writes that the classical golden ratio 1.618... is the invariant of the Fibonacci sequence.
Claims the apparatus is required for the laws of harmony of complex aggregated systems; no measurements are offered.

latest_translations.summary: A chapter of A.P. Argues historians of computing underrate numeration systems in the history of calculating devices.

Authors attribute two polarities to the ankh cross: handle "Green +", opposite end "Green -".
They liken the pharaoh's curved sceptre to a horseshoe magnet with unequal branches, and claim it can act as a detector.
They claim the uraeus emits strongly and that several uraei in series would add their action into an intense field.
They report tele-radiesthesia on a Champollion plate, inferring an underground network joining the sphinx to the Great Pyramid.

Shipov's Vacuum Equations and the New Scientific Paradigm

The history of the creation of Shipov's Vacuum Equations begins with his geometrization of the equations of Maxwell-Lorentz classical electrodynamic
latest_translations.summary: A Russian-language expository article by M.A. Lobova on the origin of G.I. Shipov's vacuum equations. It reports Shipov's 1972 geometrization of Maxwell-Lorentz electrodynamics, in which the electron is said to move along a geodesic of a curved space created by the nucleus so that it does not radiate, and his 1976 use of a ten-dimensional space of orientable points to geometrize the matter field. Lobova presents these as solutions to Einstein's two problems. The article is exposition, not new results; the claims are attributed to Shipov.
points: Author M.A. Lobova; expository article on Shipov's vacuum equations.
Reports Shipov's 1972 proposal that the electron moves along a geodesic of a curved space created by the nucleus, so it does not radiate.
Says this removes the need for Bohr's postulate of stationary orbits.
Reports Shipov's 1976 use of a ten-dimensional space of orientable points (spin) to geometrize the matter field.
Frames the work as solutions to Einstein's two problems (geometrizing electrodynamics and the matter field).
Cites E. Cartan (1922) on rotation of matter generating torsion of spacetime.

latest_translations.summary: An Italian Wikipedia encyclopedia article on 'Goethean science,' the approach to nature study adopted by Johann Wolfgang von Goethe in works such as The Metamorphosis of Plants and the Theory of Colours. The article describes its philosophical basis, the concept of the Urphaenomen (primal phenomenon), and its later development by Rudolf Steiner, and notes it is considered a pseudoscience when understood as science.
points: Goethean science is named for Goethe's method in his scientific essays, notably The Metamorphosis of Plants and the Theory of Colours.
It centres on the Urphaenomen (primal phenomenon), such as the archetypal plant (Urpflanze) and light.
Goethe's colour theory was formulated in opposition to Newton's, which he judged abstract and one-sided.
Rudolf Steiner, an editor of Goethe's works, adopted the perspective and applied it to anthroposophy.
The article notes the approach is considered a pseudoscience as science, but could be regarded as a form of phenomenology.

finds.title: Deuterium–deuterium fusion in palladium/titanium foils plateaus 10¹⁸ above isolated-nucleus theory
finds.description: Thomas Schenkel (Berkeley), Jeremy Munday, Micah Karahadian (UC Davis), *Nature Communications*, reported 2026-10-10. In 0.25 mm Pd and Ti foils, the D–D fusion rate plateaus below ~2 keV rather than collapsing, exceeding isolated-nucleus predictions by >10¹⁸; electrochemical deuterium loading roughly doubles the yield. Independent confirmation reported from Konrad Czerski's group (University of Szczecin, EU CleanHME project) in zirconium, palladium and titanium. Source: https://www.hypothesiswire.com/articles/deuterium-fusion-in-foils-plateau-at-rates-10-18-above-theory-e47fbd21 · Domain: LENR / nuclear. **The most significant mainstream-venue low-energy fusion result of the window; absolute yields remain far below reactor scale.**

finds.title: Reconciling the Adsorbed Water Layer with the Exclusion Zone: A Magnetic Field Model
finds.description: J. Nygren, 2026-03-04. Proposes that the ~1 nm adsorbed water layer is the true "fourth phase," generating a magnetic field that diamagnetically orders the much larger exclusion zone; reconciles Pollack's EZ with conventional surface science (the EZ releases ~250,000× fewer protons than a fully fourth-phase zone would, matching ~1 nm of fourth-phase water). Source: https://exa.ai/library/publication/mrdll2kqrvk · Domain: water structure / exclusion zone.

finds.title: Water's Two Local Structures and Space-Phase (SP3)
finds.description: James E. Beecham (University of Florida), Zenodo preprint 2026-07-11. Reinterprets the 2026 *Nature Physics* two-structure finding (Li et al., ~74 million configurations via unsupervised deep learning) under an assumption that a "Space-Phase" medium has finite organization, memory and relaxation; generates testable predictions on hysteresis and relaxation. Source: https://exa.ai/library/publication/8jtty9x35k8 · Domain: water structure / phenomenology. **Non-peer-reviewed; recorded as the author's own.**

finds.title: The importance of layer-dependent molecular twisting for the structural anisotropy of interfacial water
finds.description: Alexander P. Fellows et al., *Science Advances* 12, adz5505 (2026); reported in German by Fritz-Haber-Institut / chemie.de / gwf-wasser.de, 2026-04/05. Depth-resolved vibrational spectroscopy + simulation shows the first four water layers at the air–water interface alternate tilt and **twist** angles; the previously neglected depth-dependent twist-angle distribution is fundamental, and the standard "up/down" structural analysis is inadequate. Source: https://gwf-wasser.de/forschung-und-entwicklung/der-wassertwist/ · Domain: water structure / interfacial chemistry. **Mainstream; on-axis for the Water Register.**

finds.title: Entropic–Dielectric Interplay Governs Ion Adsorption in Inner Electric Double Layers
finds.description: M. Olgiati et al., *Science Advances* (2026), TU Wien + Uni Wien + University of Oslo (MECS cluster); reported 2026-05-18/19. A quantitative thermodynamic model (AFM + MD + spectroscopy) predicting which ions adsorb to surfaces from the statistical order (entropy) of water; Valtiner explicitly states this is **not** "magic water memory." Source: https://www.tuwien.at/tu-wien/aktuelles/news/die-struktur-des-wassers-entropie-entscheidet-ob-ionen-haften · Domain: water structure / counter-integrity. **The "negative half" for the Water Register.**

finds.description: Steven B. Krivit & Michael J. Ravnitzky, *European Journal of Applied Physics* 8(5), 1–20, published 2026-09-21. Peer-reviewed review: net thermal output exceeding total system electrical input, lasting days to weeks, repeatable by originating groups and reproducible by independent labs; documents the decade-long shift from Pd–D₂ electrolytic to Ni–H₂ gas-phase systems with engineered nanomaterials; LENR products differ from D–D fusion branching. Source: https://eu-opensci.org/index.php/ejphysics/article/view/70694 · Domain: LENR. **Peer-reviewed review; the authors' claims.**

finds.title: A New and Improved Understanding of Cold Fusion Based on the Observed Behavior
finds.description: Edmund Storms (Santa Fe, NM), *J. Condensed Matter Nucl. Sci.* 41 (2026) 1–18. The updated Storms model: fusion requires a Nuclear Active Environment (NAE) — a void of specific small size — where a large local electron assembly reduces the Coulomb barrier; D + D → ⁴H → ⁴He by beta emission, with neutrons/transmutation as secondary reactions. Source: https://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/StormsEanewandimpa.pdf · Domain: LENR.

works.summary: A Yonhap News report by Kim Yong-tae on research from UNIST led by Prof. Shin Hyung-joon of the Department of Materials Science and Engineering. The article reports that the team experimentally demonstrated that the collective rotational motion of water molecules enhances proton tunnelling, a quantum effect in which a proton passes through rather than over an energy barrier. Using scanning tunnelling microscopy, the researchers arranged three water molecules into a triangle on a thin salt film under ultra-high vacuum and ultra-low temperature, and reported that an applied voltage shifted the triangle toward an equilateral shape. The result was published in Nano Letters.

Molecules kept under ultra-high vacuum and ultra-low temperature to stop them evaporating.

A voltage applied via the STM probe drove the triangle toward an equilateral shape.

works.summary: A theoretical physics paper by G.I. Shipov and M.I. Podarovskaya examining a geometric representation of the hydrodynamic formalism of quantum mechanics for a particle with spin. Using the Takabayashi-Madelung geometric-hydrodynamic approach on a three-dimensional manifold of oriented points in the geometry of Absolute Parallelism, the authors argue that the spinor wave is an ensemble of the smallest vacuum vortices and constitutes a torsion field. They propose that the quantum potential and quantum moment arise from torsion fields, and use this to interpret Aharonov-Bohm-type experiments.
